elements.name: Shape language

Repeat the same shard angle across the figure
Check the silhouette in solid black

elements.name: Proportions

elements.token: Stylized heroic proportions: small head, broad shoulders, tapered waist, long elastic limbs, and hands and feet oversized to about one and a half times natural size.

elements.name: Perspective push
